belief_text: My approach blends modern sophistication with timeless charm, drawing on nature and on the city. I want every home I work on to reflect the people in it and to bring joy, connection and a real sense of belonging.
text: My creative roots are in theatre design, where I first discovered how colour, light and the smallest details can completely change the way a space makes you feel. I went on to train professionally in interior design, bringing that love of storytelling and a little theatrical flair into the everyday. I founded Mills to create imaginative, characterful interiors that don't just look beautiful, but make a real difference to how people live, work and connect.

lead: With a background in theatre design, I've always been fascinated by the power of a space to tell a story, stir emotion and leave a lasting impression. It's this belief that shapes my approach to creating characterful, meaningful interiors for homes and businesses.
belief_quote: “Every space has the power to change how we feel, think and live.”
